steps.detail: Called Harbor Light Internal Medicine at (555) 010-0211: pressed 3 (referrals and authorizations), then transferred to the doctor's medical assistant, waited 29 minutes on hold, reached Rob, the doctor's medical assistant. The doctor will sign the letter and the office will fax it. Reference R-17296.

steps.title: Match the evidence to the plan's rules
steps.detail: Mapped 12 pieces of evidence to the plan's 4 rules: 0 met, 1 partly.

steps.title: Write the appeal
steps.detail: Drafted by the writer agent from the facts on file only, and checked: 5 of 5 checks passed.

steps.title: Stress-test the appeal
steps.detail: Stress-tested over 1 round: 1 reason to deny still stands. Every reason left needs evidence that isn't on file yet; rewording can't fix that. PJ listed exactly what's missing; you can still sign and send.

review.original:
Dear Appeals Unit at Bluewater Health,

I am writing to appeal the denial of home health physical therapy on 2026-10-20, case number SIM-PA-20431. My member ID is BWM-77031882 under the Bluewater Medicare Advantage HMO. Please review my case again and send me a written decision.

You stated the information does not show that I am homebound or that skilled therapy in my home is medically necessary, and that outpatient physical therapy is available. I respectfully disagree.

Leaving home takes a considerable and taxing effort for me. I had an emergency visit after a fall at home on 2026-04-03. I live alone; Alex visits twice a week. I stopped driving last year, and I have no easy way to get to appointments.

My treating doctor is Dr. Samuel Okafor at Harbor Light Internal Medicine. A letter of medical necessity was requested from his office, reference R-17296. He will sign the letter and the office will fax it to certify my plan of care for this therapy.

Skilled therapy is needed to restore and keep my function after my emergency visit after a fall at home on 2026-04-03.

These services are reasonable and necessary for my condition. I have a heart rhythm problem (atrial fibrillation), I had an emergency visit after a fall at home on 2026-04-03, and I take 6 daily medicines on my list.

Please approve home health physical therapy. I am enclosing my doctor’s letter of medical necessity, medical records, and the denial notice.
